name: Periapt of Health
summary: A pendant that restores 2d4 + 2 Hit Points once a day.

stats.effect:
While wearing this pendant, you can take a {ref:glossary/magic} action to regain 2d4 + 2 {ref:glossary/hit-points}. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

In addition, you have {ref:glossary/advantage} on saving throws to avoid or end the {ref:condition/poisoned} condition while you wear this pendant.
